title: Minecraft-style MOTDs, white buttons and softer panels
description: Partner-server MOTDs speak in Minecraft's own symbols instead of Windows colour emojis, the store, the mod list and the settings sit on a rounded panel in front of the wallpaper, and every solid button is white now.
changes: Partner-server MOTDs: Windows colour emojis are rewritten to Minecraft's monochrome symbols
Modrinth, the mod list and Settings sit on one soft rounded panel, inset from the edges of the page
Solid buttons - Search, Download, Update, Browse files, pager, settings - are white instead of dark
News moved further down, banners shown at natural size without cropping or stretching
Hovering a news item zooms its banner slightly
The memory slider has a thicker, brand-pink knob

title: Partner servers, the changelog rail and in-game BestClient
description: The Play screen now shows live partner-server status you can join with a double-click, the mod list finally covers everything that is actually installed, and the client ships with its own in-game mod.
changes: Partner servers: live player count, MOTD and server icon, queried directly from the server
Double-click a partner server to launch straight onto it
Fixed the server lookup so a server published on an SRV record is reachable
New changelog rail down the right-hand side, on every screen
The mod list now shows pack mods, Modrinth installs and jars you added yourself, all in one place
Search your own mods, and switch any mod to a different Modrinth build
Modrinth store: sorting, twelve results per page, and a grid that never leaves a half-empty row
BestClient's own mod ships with the client and cannot be removed - Right Shift opens the in-game menu
The game console rises from the bottom the moment a launch starts
Automatic update check, with the install left to you
Hardened the launcher: strict content policy, allow-list sanitizer for remote content, and stricter file handling

title: First build
description: Microsoft sign-in, the Fabric 1.21.11 install pipeline, the Modrinth store and the PvP-tuned defaults.
changes: Microsoft device-code sign-in with multiple accounts
Fabric 1.21.11 install pipeline with automatic dependency resolution
Modrinth store for extra mods
PvP-tuned JVM flags and options.txt baseline
